operatorAliases: SWT Anstalt des öffentlichen Rechts der Stadt Trier

stationScope.evidence: BNetzA-derived public station records identify DE*SWT on SWT-operated stations, including DESWTE002601 at Rindertanzstrasse and DESWTE008501 at Europa-Allee. SWT's public electromobility content states the business-card own-network AC/DC price at 38.65 ct/kWh gross. The price is limited to charging at SWT-operated points; roaming is explicitly different.

blockingFeeDeferred.reason: The published SWT business offer includes a 0.10 EUR/min standing surcharge after 240 minutes AC or 60 minutes DC, capped at 12 EUR, with a 20:00-08:00 exemption. This time-window rule is intentionally not encoded here until the V9 pricing schema has a verified representation for time-of-day blocking-fee exemptions.

roamingDeferred.reason: SWT publishes separate roaming prices. They are eMSP terms and must not be attached to third-party physical CPOs.

note: Only the exact SWT own-network business tariff is modeled. Consumer/ad-hoc prices discovered through aggregators are not promoted without an operator-controlled current source.
